notes: Stories created for server-side scope enforcement aligned to existing tool_router allowlist behavior.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for scope enforcement
Added core logic story for scope validation

BL-0.1.4-001-S1.title: Define Tool Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-001-S1.description: Define a strict schema for tool scope including allowed tools per context, request metadata requirements, and enforcement rules to be applied server-side before dispatch.

BL-0.1.4-001-S2.title: Implement Core Scope Validation Logic
BL-0.1.4-001-S2.description: Build validation logic that checks each tool call against the defined scope contract, rejecting or sanitizing calls that fall outside the allowlist or permitted context.

BL-0.1.4-001-S3.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into Tool Router Dispatch
BL-0.1.4-001-S3.description: Integrate scope validation into the existing tool_router dispatch pipeline so that all tool calls are intercepted and validated before execution.

BL-0.1.4-001-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
BL-0.1.4-001-S4.description: Create tests validating allowed vs blocked tool calls, malformed inputs, and edge cases ensuring no out-of-scope execution paths bypass enforcement.

BL-0.1.4-001.mitigation: Leverage existing allowlist mechanism and extend with minimal validation layer.
